name: Strety
description:
Strety is the EOS® software people love — where you can run the Entrepreneurial Operating System with a comprehensive digital toolbox and use built-in Power Ups to manage projects, performance, and engagement — all in one place. 

Strety's Claude connector provides secure, real-time
access to your Strety workspace, so you can review and act on your
company's operating data through natural conversation.

Check a Rock's status, pull this week's Scorecard numbers, see what's on the Issues list, or check who owns a seat on the Accountability Chart. Then act on it: create and complete To-dos, resolve Issues, leave comments, post Headlines and Shoutouts, prep or recap Level 10 meetings, and build projects — all without leaving Claude. Plus, use the connector to connect your other MCP-connected tools with Strety via Claude for a single pane of glass view of your org.

Everything is organized by team and by person, mirroring how your
company already works in Strety. 

Access is scoped to your own Strety organization and respects your
existing permissions — Claude only sees and changes what you already
can.

Built for integrators, EOS leadership teams, EOS Implementers™, and people who manage their work lives in Strety. Keep your priorities, metrics, and traction moving between meetings.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Strety to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Strety to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://2.strety.com/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Strety MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Strety lists 54 MCP tools, including add_checklist_item, checkin_metric, checkin_project, checkin_rock, comment_on_resource, complete_checklist_item, complete_todo, create_doc, create_headline, create_issue, create_message, and create_metric.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Strety?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 18, 2026, alternatives to Strety in productivity on the Manufact MCP catalog include Autodesk Product Help, BoardWise, FlagStat, Keenable Web Search, and PomoDial.
Strety requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Strety is developed by Strety. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
